dedupe_keys.name: urban greening database 都市緑化テータヘース mlit japan

description: The urban greening database of Japan's Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism collects, for each national urban green-space scheme, a short overview PDF and an Excel table of the municipalities using it. Schemes include the green basic plans (緑の基本計画) that municipalities adopt, special green conservation districts, management agreements, suburban green conservation areas, scenic districts, productive green land, greening areas, green agreements and certified citizen green spaces. The MLIT City Bureau parks and green spaces division publishes it. The green basic plan table, for example, lists each municipality by prefecture with the name of its plan, from Hakodate onward, in about 2,900 text cells. Coverage is all of Japan's municipalities. Format and access: Excel and PDF downloads on one ministry page, in Japanese. Licence: MLIT website terms, not read on this page; free. Caveats: the tables list plans and designations, not mapped green areas, and the update date is not shown. It supports national comparisons of green infrastructure policy uptake and adaptation planning. Related catalogue records are MLIT's green cover distribution maps and the MLIT green infrastructure portal.
